info.title: Zoho CRM Assistant (Read-only)
info.description: This is a read-only Zoho CRM assistant. Use this tool for CRM modules including Leads, Contacts, Accounts, Deals, Products, Calls, Tasks, Meetings (maps to Events), Events, Quotes, and custom CRM modules. The user's explicitly requested CRM module is authoritative. Never substitute another CRM module and never route CRM requests to Zoho Books. The endpoint accepts a natural-language question and returns a normalized CRM response.

servers.description: Production backend URL (updated to your Render service)

post.summary: Ask the read-only Zoho CRM assistant a natural-language question
post.description: Accepts a natural-language CRM question and returns a normalized, read-only CRM response. Supports dynamic module resolution, live metadata-driven field resolution, date filters, sorting, aggregation, grouping, pagination, comparisons, and diagnostics. Meetings maps to Events. Do not route CRM requests to Zoho Books.

bearerAuth.description: OAuth2 access token is required by the backend. Do not include refresh tokens, client secrets, or other credentials in the OpenAPI file.

question.description: Natural-language read-only Zoho CRM question. Preserve the user's explicitly requested CRM module and date range. Examples: 'give me today's leads', 'show meetings this week', 'compare calls and meetings this month'.

conversation_id.description: Optional conversation identifier to enable conversational pagination and follow-ups.

module.description: Optional CRM display module explicitly identified by the user. Do not substitute another module. Meetings maps to Events. Examples: Leads, Contacts, Deals, Products, Calls, Tasks, Meetings, Quotes.

module_api_name.description: Optional exact Zoho CRM API module name resolved from live CRM metadata. Do not invent this value.

request_type.description: Optional read-only operation: records, count, aggregate, search, analysis, or bulk_read.

query.description: Optional planner query object. The backend resolves module, fields, filters, sort, grouping, and date range from the natural-language question; use this only to override or supply explicit planner details. Keep simple primitives.

limit.description: Maximum number of CRM records to return. Default 20. Maximum 200.

offset.description: Number of records to skip for pagination.

returned.description: Number of records returned in this response.

more_records.description: Whether more records are available for subsequent pages.

Diagnostics.description: Safe request-routing and upstream CRM diagnostics. Never contains secrets or tokens.

question.description: The original question sent by the user.

resolved_module.description: CRM display module resolved from the question.

module_api_name.description: Exact Zoho CRM API module used for execution.

resolved_fields.description: API field names resolved via live metadata.

resolved_filters.description: Filters resolved from the natural-language question.

request_type.description: Normalized request type executed by the backend.

zoho_endpoint.description: Safe path of the upstream Zoho endpoint called (no host).

zoho_http_status.description: Upstream Zoho HTTP status when available.

zoho_error_code.description: Upstream Zoho error code when available.

zoho_error_message.description: Upstream Zoho error message when available.

details.description: Optional structured details with upstream status and message.

success.description: Whether the CRM request completed successfully.

module.description: CRM display module resolved from the user's request.

module_api_name.description: Exact Zoho CRM API module used for execution.

data.description: Normalized CRM records returned by Zoho CRM.

records.description: Alias for data - normalized CRM records.

count.description: Number of records returned by this request.

total.description: Total number of records matching the query when available.

answer.description: Natural-language summary generated from the CRM result.
